instruction: A candid documentary photograph in a medium shot captures a cozy indoor setting near a window. The woman in the white shirt (R2) stands behind the seated man in the brown knit sweater (R1), wrapping her arms around his shoulders in a warm embrace. She leans forward, resting her head gently against his, with a serene expression. The man (R1) sits at a table covered with a white tablecloth, smiling softly with his eyes closed as he holds her hands. On the table in the foreground, a yellow pill organizer and a pair of glasses are visible. Soft, natural light streams from the window on the right, illuminating the couple with warm tones and creating a tender, intimate atmosphere.
